# E621 Feed

> Self-hosted personalised feed engine for e621. Import favourites, build
> per-account preference profiles, serve scored + diversified recommendations
> via an 11-channel ensemble model.

## Project

- Source: https://github.com/Basedfloppa/e621-Account-Parser
- Live: https://e621feed.zorolin.rs
- License: MIT-0 (No Attribution)

## Docs

- Main README: https://github.com/Basedfloppa/e621-Account-Parser/blob/master/Readme.md
- Scoring knobs reference: https://github.com/Basedfloppa/e621-Account-Parser/blob/master/docs/scoring.md
- Calibration & backtesting guide: https://github.com/Basedfloppa/e621-Account-Parser/blob/master/docs/calibration.md
- Production deployment: https://github.com/Basedfloppa/e621-Account-Parser/blob/master/docs/deployment.md

## API

The backend serves a JSON API under `/api`. All mutating endpoints require a
cookie-based session token (bootstrapped via `POST /api/session/bootstrap`).
The full OpenAPI spec is available at `/api/openapi.json` in dev mode only —
in production it is blocked by nginx.

The API surface covers: session management, account CRUD, favourites import
with background progress polling, scored + diversified feed recommendations
with session-based cross-page dedup, feed interaction logging (single +
batch), similar-post lookup by tag overlap, and a daily digest with
stratified sampling + 24 h TTL cache.

## Architecture

- **Backend:** Rust (Rocket 0.5), SQLite (WAL mode), rayon for parallel scoring
- **Frontend:** Yew 0.21 (WASM), Bootstrap 5, Chart.js, d3-force for tag graph
- **Scoring:** 11-channel ensemble (similarity, quality, recency, rating, media,
  popularity, interaction, tag-relation PMI, uploader, exclusivity, novelty)
  with MMR diversification and ε-greedy exploration
- **Calibration:** Offline grid search over ~80 knobs with NDCG@20 / Recall@50 /
  MRR + bootstrap 95% CI
